title: Choose Lean — round 3
question: More creative, and the rider is the graphic. Still Broadcast Booth Glass: night-ink plaque, orange is you, Exo 2 ExtraBold Italic. Flat HUD silhouette, not a photo.

options.label: Figure
options.thesis: A real MX rider from behind is the needle. The body leans 32°. Orange degrees sit as a TV bug on the figure.
options.viewport: Square plaque. White rear-view rider+bike (helmet, bars, boots) leaned 32° right, filling the glass. Orange 32° as a small skew bug on the rider. Steer 30% as a thin hairline under the boots.
options.risk: If the silhouette is crude it becomes the toy bike again.

options.label: Ghost
options.thesis: Two riders, one hub. Dim upright ghost, white leaned body. The gap is the lean.
options.viewport: Square plaque. Dim upright rider in the center. White rider rotated 32° on the same hub. Orange 32° between them. Steer as orange handlebar on the white rider only.
options.risk: Two figures can muddy the glance at race speed.

options.label: Bar + body
options.thesis: One rear-view: the rider leans, the bars turn on their own. Lean and steer are two layers of the same drawing.
options.viewport: Square plaque. White rider torso+bike leaned 32°. Orange handlebar rotated independently 30% right. Huge orange 32° left of the figure, small white 30% right. Spectate drops the orange bar.
options.risk: Two angles on one figure can fight if the bar isn’t clearly orange.
